covers: Session cookies, token refresh, email/OTP + Google/Apple social sign-in, identity linking/unlinking, account deletion.

token_refresh.logic: try access token once; on 401 call POST /auth/refresh with refresh token; retry the call with new access token; on a second 401 or missing tokens, clear all session cookies and return 401 'Your session has expired. Please sign in again.'
token_refresh.used_by: every bff route handler that requires auth

identity_display.mechanism: backend mints dev-auth.<base64url payload>.<hmac>; decodes payload[1] only, checks kind==='access' and exp not expired
identity_display.trust_level: UNVERIFIED — signature cannot be checked client/server-side here (secret is backend-only); display only, never authorization. Real requests still send the token to backend which verifies it.
identity_display.no_me_endpoint: there is no GET /user/me; this decode is the only way to show the signed-in address

social_signin.flow: exchangeSocialToken('/auth/social/google'|'/auth/social/apple', body) -> backend returns either a session (SessionPair+email) or {linkRequired:true, linkTicket, suggestedEmail} when the identity's email cannot be trusted (e.g. Apple Hide My Email, or first sign-in with unverified address)
social_signin.link_flow: LinkEmailStep.tsx redeems linkTicket via OTP to claim an email; ticket kept in component state, never put in a URL
social_signin.render_guard: each button renders ONLY when its NEXT_PUBLIC_*_CLIENT_ID/SERVICES_ID env var is non-empty (backend 503s an unconfigured provider otherwise) — a non-empty-but-WRONG value still renders and then fails at runtime (see historical bug f013)
google_requirements: site origin must be an Authorized JavaScript origin in Google Cloud Console (missing origin => generic-looking 'policy' error that is actually redirect_uri_mismatch, f014)
Google ignores port for localhost origins, masking missing prod origin during local testing
apple_requirements: NEXT_PUBLIC_APPLE_SERVICES_ID is a Services ID (e.g. com.uplisoft.velocityesim.web), distinct from and NOT equal to the app bundle id com.uplisoft.velocityesim (Apple forbids equality)
must be registered under the SAME primary App ID as mobile so Apple issues one shared `sub` across platforms
Apple Developer portal must have the Services ID created, SIWA enabled, grouped under the App ID, with domain esim.uplisoft.com and return URL https://esim.uplisoft.com/signin
social_signin.web_apple_limitation: src/app/bff/auth/social/apple/route.ts deliberately omits authorizationCode (a code minted for the web Services ID would be rejected by Apple against APPLE_BUNDLE_ID) => web-only Apple accounts have no stored refresh token => revoke-on-delete does not cover them (f015, open item f031)

identity_management.profile_section: '/profile' Sign-in methods section: GET /auth/identities (list linked providers), DELETE /bff/auth/identities/[provider] (unlink)
identity_management.backend_guard: 409 from backend when trying to unlink the only remaining sign-in method — surfaced to the user verbatim
identity_management.private_relay_display: an Apple private-relay email is shown as literal string 'Hidden email', never as a real inbox address
